reason: Adds a dsh Web settings tab that presents installed Cordis plugin descriptions and metadata with grouping, search, and status filters while leaving the official plugin list unchanged.

summaries.zh: 为 dsh Web 插件设置区新增说明标签页，展示已安装 Cordis 插件的描述、包名、entryId 和挂载状态，并支持分组、搜索与过滤。
summaries.en: Adds a dsh Web plugin settings tab that displays descriptions and metadata for installed Cordis plugins with grouping, search, and status filters.

capabilities: Adds a settings panel for viewing installed plugin metadata and descriptions
Reads installed plugin package.json metadata at request time
Registers a local HTTP endpoint for plugin metadata
Provides install and uninstall scripts that modify the dsh web profile plugin configuration
